department: Department of Chemistry (Chemistry and Chemical Biology Ph.D.)

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027 entry; the fee-waiver pre-application closes earlier, on November 1, 2026.
deadline.quote: For Fall 2027 Admission, please apply by December 1, 2026 at 11:59pm PST

fee_waiver.value: The department grants only a small number of fee waivers, after a pre-application by November 1, 2026.
fee_waiver.quote: A small number of fee waivers will be granted to excellent candidates who can demonstrate a clear need for a fee waiver.

toefl_min.value: The department's own minimum is 5.0 out of 6.0 for TOEFL tests from 21 January 2026; the university page says 4.5.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum Score: A minimum TOEFL score of 100 is required for TOEFL exams taken prior to January 21, 2026 (old scoring), and a minimum score of 5.0 out of 6.0 is required for exams taken on or after January 21, 2026.

also.quote: a minimum score of 4.5 out of 6.0 is required for exams taken on or after January 21, 2026

funding.value: Admitted Ph.D. students may receive a competitive stipend, with tuition and fees paid.
funding.quote: Students admitted to the Ph.D. program may receive a competitive stipend

entry_route.value: The entry requirement is a bachelor's degree in chemistry, biochemistry, physics or a related STEM major.
entry_route.quote: A B.S. or B.A. in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Physics (for the Chemical Physics emphasis) or related undergraduate STEM major.
